levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Sorts items mostly by guessing or by how long ago they were worn, without naming a stain, smell, or wear-count check.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Applies at least two of the three checks (stain, smell, wear count) consistently across the pile.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Applies all three checks to every item and explains a specific decision using more than one check together.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Several items are placed in a pile that clearly contradicts the checks the learner just described.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Every item lands in a pile that matches the checks the learner described for it.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Every item matches its checks, and the learner correctly identifies the one hardest item and names the specific check that tipped the decision.

lookFors: The learner names a specific item, not just a pile count, when describing the hardest decision.
The reflection response names a specific item and a specific check, not a vague 'some things surprised me.'

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
